events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop debut
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, lasting four days.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which iconic performance stands out for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley on the anniversary of his passing. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founder of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! An undeniable force in rock music with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad for it birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still sounding biblical.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Licence to thrill
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered in 1962. What's your top Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy legend birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.
